run_port_server: run the port server wrapper script to start a gRPC port server on localhost:32766
start_port_server_function: start a gRPC port server process checking for version mismatches and killing stale instances
check_port_server_version: check the running port server version via HTTP GET to localhost:32766/version_number
kill_port_server: kill an existing port server by sending an HTTP request to localhost:32766/quitquitquit
review_start_port_server: review the start_port_server wrapper script that launches the gRPC port server for C/C++ tests
